// This file is a raw-cause guard FIXTURE, not compiled package code. It is the
// negative control: a 5xx writeError call with a static-literal message and an
// allow-listed literal details map carries no raw cause, so the guard must
// report ZERO findings over it. See raw_cause_guard_test.go.
package rawcausefixture

import "net/http"

// clean: static message + allow-listed literal details, no error-derived value.
func clean(s *Server, w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request, runID string) {
	s.writeError(w, r, http.StatusInternalServerError, "internal_error",
		"a static literal message",
		map[string]any{"run_id": runID, "reason": "a static reason"})
}
